function.arguments: {"amount_usdc":1500,"cited_clauses":[1,2,5,6,7],"reasons":[{"clause":1,"finding":"Pay at the agreed day rate for eligible work; six billed days at the agreed rate are confirmed.","evidence_quote":"Day rate billed does not exceed the agreed 250 USDC."},{"clause":2,"finding":"The billed days are within the monthly cap.","evidence_quote":"Days billed: 6, within the 10-day monthly cap."},{"clause":5,"finding":"No duplicate period invoice is identified.","evidence_quote":"No other invoice on file covers this invoice number or period."},{"clause":6,"finding":"The invoice was received within 60 days of the period end.","evidence_quote":"Received 2026-09-05, 5 days after the billing period ended (2026-08-31)."},{"clause":7,"finding":"The listed work is within the agreed scope of work.","evidence_quote":"Scope of work: Blog posts, release notes and help-centre articles."}]}
